# Amiru Mallawarachchi

> AI engineering student in Moratuwa, Sri Lanka, building production-grade Gen AI systems:
> LangGraph agent workflows, MCP tool servers, retrieval pipelines, and the FastAPI and
> Next.js backends that keep them reliable. BSc (Hons) Software Engineering, graduating
> February 2027. Gen AI Engineer certification from STEMLink (outstanding distinction).

## Profile

- Role: AI Engineering Student / early-career Gen AI engineer
- Location: Moratuwa, Sri Lanka (GMT+5:30), open to remote
- Focus: agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation and guardrails, production AI backends
- Languages: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java 17, SQL, PHP
- Frameworks: LangGraph, LangChain, MCP/FastMCP, FastAPI, Next.js, Spring Boot 3, Hugging Face Transformers
- Infrastructure: Docker, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Render, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Pinecone, Supabase

## Selected work

- [MindLens](https://amiru-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/mindlens): privacy-conscious multi-agent wellbeing platform with bounded LangGraph orchestration, deterministic crisis screening before any model call, PII anonymisation, and metadata-only observability.
- [TripWeaver](https://amiru-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/multi-agent-travel-planner): intent-routed travel planner where six FastMCP services isolate flight, hotel, itinerary, weather, currency and location tools behind a LangGraph router.
- [Solvix](https://amiru-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/solvix): enterprise ticketing platform on Java 17, Spring Boot 3 and PostgreSQL with JWT/RBAC, a six-stage domain lifecycle, Flyway migrations and CI.
- [Multi-Task NLP Intelligence Suite](https://amiru-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/nlp-suite): one typed FastAPI + Next.js interface over five Hugging Face pipelines.
- [Automated Presidential Election System](https://amiru-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/election-system): multilingual election workflow selected for the EXITO'26 industry exhibition.
